kind: Actual Expo UI, synthetic microphones/cameras, real WebRTC audio/video, isolated PostgreSQL and Redis
browser: Chromium, separate rider and driver sessions

checks.name: Call icon opens audio/video chooser and selects video explicitly
camera denial creates no call and offers audio fallback
both participants consent and exchange encrypted audio and video frames
camera-off stops both cameras and reconnects audio in the same call
audio-to-video request requires peer consent and rejection preserves audio
accepted audio-to-video upgrade reuses the call and microphone, and camera-off returns to audio
motion policy disables video on both peers while preserving audio
recipient can answer a video invitation with audio without opening a camera
backgrounding a browser tab stops video capture and continues with audio
stale location disables video in the chooser while audio remains available

dataIsolation: Disposable database and Redis, fictional participants, fake camera/microphone devices, synthetic motion evidence in existing driver-location cache. Real browser peers and media transport; no recording or production users.
